items.item_text: 01. I understand that I am applying to a position that is 100% Categorically funded. I understand that this means this position is for a limited term as described in the position summary. When the funding ends, the District may eliminate these positions due to the lack of funding. If that happens, the District will provide notices to all affected employees explaining their rights under the Board Policy, Collective Bargaining Agreement, and Education Code. Options: Yes | No

02. Please indicate how you meet the qualifications for the Grant Coordination Clerk position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. Options: I have at least two (2) years of clerical experience directly related to the duties of the position. | I have one (1) year of clerical experience AND one (1) year (30 semester/45 quarter units) of college level business and clerical course work. | I do not meet minimum qualifications.
EXPERIENCE: Two years of clerical experience directly related to the duties of the position.

EDUCATION: One year of college level business and clerical course work may be substituted for up to one year of the required experience. Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment. ( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.) Education must be from an accredited institution.
